post_clip.description: The man seated at the counter repeatedly handles small items (possibly jewelry) from open display cases, then brings his hands to his head/face in a manner consistent with concealing an item (e.g., tucking into hair, cap, or clothing). His behavior is evasive and non-transactional—no payment or packaging occurs—and he avoids direct eye contact while the woman observes passively. This pattern strongly suggests shoplifting via concealment.

A second person (partially visible, wearing green) enters frame later and also handles items near the tray while the man continues suspicious manipulation, increasing concern for coordinated concealment.
